claims.claim_text: We anticipate around 98 attendees, a significant increase over earlier turnout, driven by stronger promotion.
We can deliver this Hackathon efficiently within INR 28,000, well below typical costs.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
